新能源重卡对比清单New-Energy Heavy Truck Comparison

按技术路线分三类：纯电、混动、氢能及其他新能源；已剔除纯燃油车型。每个产品大类（牵引车/自卸车等）单列一列，同一车型跨多种能源路线时在各分类下都会出现。含电驱桥、电机数量、轴距、整备质量/总质量/载重、电池包布置方式、充电接口与速率、续航与能耗等底盘级参数，并附官网与参数来源链接。 Grouped into three technology tracks — battery-electric, hybrid, and hydrogen/other new-energy — with pure fossil-fuel models excluded. Each product category (tractor, dump truck, etc.) gets its own column, and any model spanning multiple energy tracks appears under each. Includes e-axle, motor count, wheelbase, curb/gross weight and calculated payload, battery pack layout, charging port and rate, and range vs. energy-consumption figures, plus links to official pages and data sources.

亮点Highlights 能耗成本较燃油车降低 60%；三合一集成电驱桥＋底置电池布局60% lower energy cost than diesel; 3-in-1 e-axle with underslung battery 中国首款全正向设计智能新能源重卡；风阻系数0.35Cd优于特斯拉Semi(0.36Cd)；提供左右舵版本面向国际市场，已交付中东China's first ground-up-designed smart NEV heavy truck; 0.35Cd drag coefficient beats Tesla Semi's 0.36Cd; LHD/RHD for export, already delivered to the Middle East 2021–2024 中国新能源重卡销量第一；集成液冷热管理，能耗降低20%；最大爬坡度30%China's #1 NEV heavy-truck seller 2021–2024; integrated liquid-cooling thermal management cuts energy use 20%; 30% max grade 双电机双变速箱冗余设计，单组失效动力不中断；800V平台1000A超充，30分钟补能300km；最大爬坡28%Dual-motor/dual-transmission redundancy keeps power flowing if one fails; 800V/1000A charging adds 300km in 30min; 28% max grade 与宾尼法利纳（Pininfarina）合作设计；行业首创"云渡"线控底盘；宽体2040mm驾驶室平地板可通铺；单车年省油7200升，年减碳约19吨Designed with Pininfarina; industry-first "Yundu" wire-controlled chassis; widest-in-class 2040mm flat-floor cab with pass-through berth; saves 7,200L fuel and ~19t carbon per truck per year "短途运输之王"；同平台G7车系为国内首台侧挂换电重卡（与E7是否共用换电方案未能确认）Marketed as "king of short-haul"; sibling G7 is China's first side-swap heavy truck (unclear if E7 shares that swap system) 与牵引车共享汉风E7品牌与电驱系统方案，覆盖公路+工程自卸场景Shares the Hanfeng E7 badge and drive system with the tractor; covers highway and construction dump duty 多家电芯供应商保障产能；网传"三电机1122马力"经核实实为同集团豪沃TX7-N，非本车型，已更正Multi-sourced cells for supply security; the widely-cited "1122hp tri-motor" figure actually belongs to sister brand HOWO TX7-N, corrected here 峰值功率最高600kW（816马力）；商用车专用刀片电池，抗变形/抗挤压/抗针刺，疲劳寿命超行业友商40万公里；国内唯一在公开机构通过瑞标、国标、欧标多维度碰撞测试的国产重卡Up to 600kW peak (816hp); commercial-grade blade battery resists deformation/crushing/puncture with 400,000km more fatigue life than peers; the only domestic heavy truck independently certified under Swiss, Chinese, and European crash-test standards 风阻系数低至0.28Cd，"星帆"仿生流线造型；北京到南京一次充电可达；整车B10寿命160万公里，电池最高质保300万度电；可电可氢共享平台Drag coefficient as low as 0.28 Cd with a "star-sail" bionic streamline body; one charge covers Beijing to Nanjing; 1.6M km B10 vehicle life, battery warranty up to 3M kWh throughput; shared BEV/hydrogen platform 整车能耗低至0.9kWh/km；30分钟快充(SOC20%-80%)；B10寿命150万公里，超4000项零部件验证试验；侧挂式电池布局降低重心Energy use as low as 0.9kWh/km; 30-min fast charge (20%-80% SOC); 1.5M km B10 life with 4,000+ component validation tests; side-mounted battery lowers center of gravity

亮点Highlights 深向早期宣传曾提"氢电同平台"，但目前官网、公告、IPO招股书均未见独立氢能重卡产品，以下各项参数为空并非检索能力不足，而是该产品客观上尚不存在DeepWay's early messaging mentioned a shared hydrogen/EV platform, but no independent hydrogen truck product appears on its official site, filings, or IPO prospectus — the blanks below reflect that the product doesn't exist yet, not a research gap 北京到广州一次加氢可达；6×4版百公里氢耗低至7.6公斤；燃料电池与电驱桥B10寿命达160万公里One hydrogen fill covers Beijing to Guangzhou; as low as 7.6kg H₂/100km (6×4); 1.6M km B10 life for fuel cell and e-axleBeacon概念阶段披露自研300kW金属板自增湿氢燃料电池系统，效率≥58%，星海是否延续未证实The Beacon concept stage cited an in-house 300kW self-humidifying metal-plate fuel cell at ≥58% efficiency — unconfirmed whether Xinghai carries this over 全球首款量产液氢重卡；15分钟加注续航破1000km；燃料电池与电驱桥B10寿命达160万公里World's first production liquid-H₂ heavy truck; 15-min refuel for >1,000km range; 1.6M km B10 life for fuel cell and e-axle 智能移动生活舱（淋浴/卧室/厨房）；同系列另有4X2 18T版本及甲醇直驱版（内燃机+12AMT机械驱动，无电驱系统）Smart "living cabin" (shower/bed/kitchen); the family also includes a 4×2 18T trim and a methanol direct-drive version (ICE + 12-speed AMT, no electric drive) 全球首发大功率低氢耗；可用氢气量较行业提高37.5%；整车自重≤11.5t轻量化设计；储氢系统随型设计降低5%风阻Claimed world-first high-power/low-consumption launch; 37.5% more usable hydrogen than industry norms; ≤11.5t curb weight via lightweighting; conformal hydrogen storage cuts drag 5%

数据整理自卡车之家(360che.com)参数配置表、卡车网(chinatruck.org)、工信部道路机动车辆生产企业及产品公告、王力汽车网(cn-truck.com)公告库、长城商用车官网(ifyou.com)、深向科技官网及官方规格书(deepway.com)，以及厂商官网与行业媒体报道；部分字段因360che.com反爬限制改用同类结构化站点交叉核实。已剔除无新能源版本的纯燃油车型（如解放 J6E — "J6 EXPRESS" 实为柴油/LNG 快递版牵引车，未见量产电动/混动版本）；欧曼银河9、汕德卡 C7M 本身以柴油/LNG 为主，此处仅展示其新能源变体。三一电动轻卡为6吨级载货车，与表中其他重卡不属同一吨位级别，按用户要求纳入对比并置于三一重卡各车型旁，"牵引总质量 GCW"一栏对其不适用；三一氢能重卡"长空200"数据同样来自三一重卡官网(31truck.com/sanytruck.com)及国际版页面。卡文星海（原Beacon概念车，2026-08-28正式量产上市）一栏已改用星海量产版官方数据，官网更正为福田汽车官网(foton.com.cn)——此前误用的cavanauto.com并非官方站点，且未找到英文官网；量产版与Beacon概念阶段存在数据差异之处（如电池容量、续航、充电速率、电驱桥效率等）均已在备注中注明两个阶段的数值，不做强行统一，实拍图也已更换为福田官网发布的星海量产版实车图（此前为Beacon概念车图片）。远程星瀚H的纯电版与醇氢电动版数据已用官网(geelycv.com中文站/global.geelycv.com英文站)更新，两个站点披露的电池容量、续航、充电速率等数字不完全一致（如中文站545–660kWh对英文站600kWh），可能对应不同配置或更新时间差，均已如实并列未强行统一；此前"朱雀电驱桥"与参数表博世电机的冲突，经中文官网确认"朱雀"为自研电驱桥名称（750–880Ps），冲突已解决；实拍图同样更换为官网发布的量产实车图。"牵引总质量 GCW"指牵引车头挂上满载半挂车后的整套车列总重量，是牵引车真正的整车列重量上限；它不是"总质量(GVW)减整备质量"能算出来的——GVW只是牵引车头本身被允许装到的重量（主要是鞍座/牵引销负荷能力，不是货厢载货量），GCW则是厂商直接给出的车列总重指标，因此这里不做换算，直接采用厂商披露的数值。徐工汉风E7自卸车没有牵引挂车，标"不适用"。"尺寸""轴距""官网""参考来源""欧盟WVTA认证""技术对标"均为后续新增字段，仅使用调研中已经查到的资料填充，未查到的一律留空（"—"），未做额外检索，仅"技术对标"一项按要求做过定向搜索补充；经二次核查，三一SE636与比亚迪Q3已确认获得欧盟WVTA认证（均附来源），徐工与卡文品牌层面有相关报道但未点名具体车型，已在备注中说明不应直接套用；深向星辰氢能版经核实为早期概念表述、无实际产品，相关字段留空是事实反映而非检索不足；标注"未找到"处为此前检索时未查到该字段的结构化数据，同一车型不同配置下参数存在差异时已如实列出区间或代表配置。部分表述存在信源冲突（如电驱桥描述、电机功率数字）已在备注中说明，未做主观取舍。仅供内部选型对比参考，非采购依据。 Compiled from 360che.com spec sheets, chinatruck.org, MIIT vehicle-production filings, cn-truck.com's filing database, GWM Commercial's official site (ifyou.com), DeepWay's official site and spec sheets (deepway.com), OEM sites, and trade press; some fields were cross-checked via equivalent structured sources because 360che.com blocked automated access. Pure fossil-fuel models with no new-energy variant are excluded (e.g. FAW Jiefang J6E — "J6 EXPRESS" is a diesel/LNG express tractor with no production EV/hybrid version); Auman Galaxy 9 and SITRAK C7M are primarily diesel/LNG models, so only their new-energy variants are shown here. The SANY Electric Light Truck is a 6t-class cargo truck, a different weight class from the rest of the table, and is included at the user's request next to SANY's other trucks; the "GCW" row does not apply to it. SANY's "Changkong 200" hydrogen truck is likewise sourced from SANY Truck's official site (31truck.com/sanytruck.com) and its international listing. The CAVAN Xinghai columns (formerly the Beacon concept, officially launched into production on Aug 28, 2026) now use production-spec figures; the official site is corrected to Foton's own site (foton.com.cn) — cavanauto.com, used earlier, is not the official site, and no English site was found; where the production version differs from the earlier Beacon concept (battery capacity, range, charging rate, e-axle efficiency, etc.), both figures are noted rather than reconciled, and the photos have been swapped for Foton's official Xinghai production shots (previously Beacon concept-car photos). The Farizon Homtruck H's BEV and methanol-hydrogen columns have been updated from its official sites (geelycv.com Chinese, global.geelycv.com English); the two sites disagree somewhat on battery capacity, range, and charging rate (e.g. 545–660kWh on the Chinese site vs. 600kWh on the English site), likely reflecting different trims or update timing — both are listed as-is rather than reconciled. The earlier conflict between press reports of a "Zhuque" e-axle and the spec sheet's Bosch motor is now resolved: the Chinese official site confirms "Zhuque" as the in-house e-axle name (750–880Ps). Photos have likewise been swapped for official production shots. "Gross Combination Weight (GCW)" is the total weight of the tractor plus a fully-loaded semi-trailer — a tractor's real load ceiling. It is not derived by subtracting curb weight from GVW: GVW is only what the tractor head itself is rated to carry (mostly fifth-wheel/kingpin load capacity, not cargo-box payload), while GCW is a distinct figure the OEM discloses directly, so it's used as-is rather than calculated. The XCMG Hanfeng E7 dump truck doesn't tow a trailer, so it's marked N/A. "Dimensions," "Wheelbase," "Official Site," "Source," "EU WVTA," and "Benchmarked Against" are all added in later rounds and are filled only from material already gathered; nothing was re-researched except "Benchmarked Against," which was searched on request. On a follow-up pass, SANY SE636 and BYD Q3 were confirmed to hold EU WVTA type-approval (sources included); XCMG and CAVAN have brand-level coverage but no model-specific confirmation, noted as such rather than assumed; DeepWay's hydrogen column was found to be an early-stage concept description with no real product behind it, so its blank fields reflect that fact rather than incomplete research. "Not found" marks fields with no structured data at the time of the original research, and where trims differ, a range or a representative trim is shown as-is. Where sources conflicted (e.g. e-axle claims, motor power figures), the conflict is noted rather than resolved by guesswork. For internal fleet-selection reference only, not a procurement basis.
